build_rpn_loss_computation: build an RPNLossComputation instance with a matcher, sampler, box coder, and label generation function
run_match_targets_to_anchors: run match_targets_to_anchors to compute IoU and match ground truth targets to anchor boxes
run_prepare_targets: run prepare_targets to generate labels and regression targets for anchors across images
run_rpn_loss_call: run the RPNLossComputation call to compute objectness loss and box regression loss for RPN
build_rpn_loss_evaluator: build an RPN loss evaluator from config and box coder using make_rpn_loss_evaluator
